Whisker Acres

Grow catnip, strawberries and pumpkins on your own little farm. Who's running it today?

Seed Stall

Your gold: 0g

Welcome to Whisker Acres!

Dear little farmer,

  • Pick a tool on the left, face a tile and press Use.
  • Dig in the fenced field with the hoe, plant seeds, and water them every day. Refill the can at the pond.
  • Break rocks with the pickaxe, chop branches and trees with the axe, and cut weeds with the scythe.
  • Drop your harvest in the shipping bin by the house and you'll be paid overnight.
  • The seed stall sells seeds, and makes sprinklers from wood and stone.
  • The hens live in the fenced pen. Go into the barn through its door to collect their eggs, and ship them for gold.
  • Walk through the front door to go inside. Tap Decorate to arrange beds, toys and cat things anywhere you like. Sleep in a bed before midnight!

Love, Mary & Nick

Go to bed?

The day will end and you'll wake up rested.

Escape the RoostA bat puzzle under Sacramento's bridges

The roost is jammed. Tap a bat whose arrow path is clear and it flies to one of 4 feeding slots. It eats moths of its color from the front of the line, and its number says how many it needs before it can leave. Choose which bats, and in what order.
